title: Last 3103.devA kills connection to DASH
body:
@MilosKozak The latest dev build killed things. For DASH, no more pod history (shows a blank page and then slows the AAPS UI). No more beep the pod, nor connect to pod.
![Screenshot_2022-08-10-13-42-33-738_info.nightscout.androidaps.png](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/183896256-a9f0cc2c-40e7-4b65-a7be-164917c9a165.png)

Reinstalling the older devA gets back the pod connection but losts selected profile, BG history etc.

Here is the log. Look around and before 13:55

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1660132552797.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/9299796/AndroidAPS_LOG_1660132552797.log.zip)
